paras: Application: Nissan R35 GT-R (LHD only) with Radium 20-0572 fuel hanger Part Type: Fuel hanger feed kit with stainless filter Part Number: 20-0851-03

With high-flow pumps the stock R35 fuel lines may not be sufficient. This kit connects the Radium in-tank fuel hanger directly to Radium fuel rails with new PTFE feed lines, and reuses the factory feed line as the regulator return.
hl: PTFE Feed Lines: Twin 6AN PTFE hoses from the hanger to the front rail ports
Stainless Filter: 10 micron cleanable, reusable stainless element
Check Valve: Filter has an integrated check valve to hold pressure after shutdown
Heat Shield: R35-specific filter heat shield bracket
OEM Line Reuse: Factory feed line is reused as the regulator return
10 micron stainless fuel filter with check valve
ft: Radium Engineering Fuel Hanger Feed Kit for Nissan R35 GT-R (Stainless Filter)
